explanation: The theorem says that two residual Galois representations are equivalent when their Frobenius characteristic polynomials agree, both are absolutely irreducible, and they are linked through Hecke eigenvalues. Every object in it is defined in the library: ResidualGaloisRep, GaloisRepAdic, CuspForm.heckeAlgebra, ValuationSubring.IsFrobeniusAt and baseChangeAlong. The proof chains several of the library's own lemmas (charpoly_residual, charpoly_baseChangeAlong, charpoly_eq_of_charpoly_frobenius_eq and isEquiv_of_isAbsolutelyIrreducible_of_charpoly_eq). Mathlib has no Galois representations, Frobenius charpolys or cusp-form Hecke algebras, so no Mathlib declaration carries this content. I ran no searches; the verdict rests on reading the statement and its proof.
